narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seventeen has the tallest stack, so seventeen is the mean.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But many dots sit to the right of seventeen as well.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The tallest stack is only the most common value, so that slip is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; the slip's bubble shows the tallest stack at 17 circled; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, count the dots, add the values, and divide again.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Or add the distances on each side of the mean, and see that they match.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines appear: count, add, divide; distances on both sides must match

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says seventeen has the tallest stack, so it is the mean. The tallest stack is the most common value, but the mean uses every dot.
